edits.find: Almost every breakfast worth eating can be built for under a dollar a serving if you buy the base ingredients and portion them yourself. Below are twenty that clear that bar with room to spare. The per-serving figures assume everyday grocery prices, not sale prices, so you'll likely do even better.
edits.replace: Almost every breakfast worth eating costs a small fraction of the drive-thru version if you buy the base ingredients and portion them yourself. Below are twenty that prove it.
